headline: AI Adoption Outpaces Guardrails as EdTech Week and Technical Congress Near
thesis: Fresh reporting says AI adoption is outrunning student safeguards while the autumn conference season, from EdTech Week to 1EdTech, is about to set the agenda.
summary: Inside Higher Ed reports that higher ed's AI adoption is outpacing student guardrails, and EdTech Magazine's K-12 coverage tracks Microsoft's report on K-12 AI adoption alongside district training needs for Gemini rollouts. Brookings' Global Task Force continues to argue that general-purpose AI can diminish learning unless used narrowly. Ed-Fi reports adoption in more than a quarter of states. Next up: EdTech Week (Oct 12-16, Columbia, NYC) and the 1EdTech Technical Congress (Oct 19-21, Milwaukee); ISTE+ASCD is rebranding as ISTE.
footnote: Compiled from 11 curated edtech sources · October 5, 2026 · Most publisher sites were unreachable from this environment, so items come from search-indexed results; several sources had no new dated news and list evergreen items with notes.
